new_frozen_descriptive_result.description: 32^3 Taylor-Green paired delta minus the 32^3 random256 all-fallback paired delta at the same repeat index. This is descriptive only because the initial-condition cases differ and were not randomized counterfactuals.
new_frozen_descriptive_result.interpretation: All five descriptive contrasts are positive, so 32^3 Taylor-Green remains the strongest frozen candidate for a properly controlled native rerun. This does not establish causal sparse speedup.

arms.C: guarded forced-fallback control on the SAME physical trajectory, with sparse execution disabled but wrapper/guard/fallback machinery otherwise preserved

per_repeat_contrasts.end_to_end: A_time - B_time; positive means the automatic hybrid is faster than the unmodified dense baseline
per_repeat_contrasts.attribution: C_time - B_time; positive means enabling the sparse route improves time relative to the same guarded path forced to FFT fallback
per_repeat_contrasts.negative_control: A_time - C_time; diagnoses wrapper/guard/order effects when sparse arithmetic is never executed

correctness_gate: A, B and C must start from identical deterministic state/Source inputs for each repeat
B and C must preserve Nyquist treatment, pressure/diffusion, Source ordering and RK4 staging
B and C outputs must match A within the task's frozen numerical tolerances
route logs must prove B executes at least one sparse nonlinear call and C executes zero sparse calls

order_balance.rule: Use an integer number of complete six-order cycles, with each arm appearing equally often in each ordinal position. Report confirmatory contrasts separately by order stratum; a sign reversal between order strata blocks promotion and requires further diagnosis.

confirmatory_statistics.test: exact one-sided sign test under H0 P(positive contrast) <= 0.5; ties are removed before n is counted and must be reported
confirmatory_statistics.negative_control_block: If A-C itself produces a one-sided positive sign-test result at alpha 0.05, treat the harness as exhibiting an unexplained all-fallback advantage and block sparse-speed attribution until diagnosed. Non-significance is only a diagnostic, not an equivalence proof.

instrumentation_required: raw RK4 and total trajectory time
shadow dense numerical counterfactual for each sparse-eligible call outside the production timing path

boundary: This is an experimental-design and frozen-evidence certificate only. It does not rerun the unavailable native host, does not establish generic CFD acceleration or a PDE theorem, and is not independent benchmark acceptance.
